Transport is session-local atlas-dayline-handoff/v0.1 and requires explicit ADD TO DAY.
Added explicit ESSENTIAL / CAPABILITY / EXPEDITION lanes so realistic procurement and playful market exploration share one adapter without becoming one backlog.
Lane is browser-local, filterable, exported, included in research packets and explicit Dayline handoffs; EXPEDITION denotes curiosity/research rather than purchase authority.
Added optional BODY W/D/H, OPERATING W/D/H and mass fields so physical envelope is first-class alongside landed cost.
Added SERVICE / MAINTENANCE and DEPENDENCIES / CONSUMABLES / LOCK-IN burden fields without creating a second item store.

DAYLINE and HOUSE returns preserve the exact selected Shopping item through its hash address.
Agent research packets include fit, burden and placement-home evidence.
Consumes exact Shopping-addressed atlas-dayline-source-return/v0.1 offers after Dayline RUN → WITNESS → COMPLETE → RETURN.

Stale, wrong-item, incomplete-task or non-RECEIPT_ONLY offers are read-only/dismissible.
Added derived per-item evidence signal (CLEAR / CHANGED / REALITY / EXTERNAL / MIXED) using shared FIELD semantic patterns; projection never mutates lifecycle.
Selected item exposes a collapsed evidence/reality bar with proof boundary + smallest next proof; list items carry the same recognition pattern.
Agent research packets include evidence_signal, proof_boundary and next_proof.
Shopping → Dayline now carries source-owned evidence_signal + proof_boundary inside the existing exact atlas-dayline-handoff/v0.1 source envelope; Dayline does not infer or own the token.
When NEXT ACTION is blank, explicit Dayline handoff uses the derived smallest next_proof rather than a generic Resolve placeholder.
Closed Shopping ↔ HOUSE FIT return loop: HOUSE now emits a short-lived exact-item house-shopping-fit-return/v0.1 OFFER_ONLY / EVIDENCE_ONLY result instead of navigation-only RETURN.
Shopping revalidates source route + item id/address + original lifecycle state before explicit acceptance into browser-local shopping-house-fit-receipt/v0.1 evidence.
HOUSE fit acceptance never mutates Shopping lifecycle, next action, ownership or adoption state.
Shopping-owned evidence_signal/proof_boundary travel into the HOUSE fit probe as source metadata; HOUSE renders but does not infer them.
Added explicit HUMAN PORT → Shopping candidate ingress: one exact Port object/focus becomes a short-lived OFFER_ONLY / CANDIDATE_ONLY Shopping offer.
Shopping shows the pending Port offer separately and requires explicit ADD AS VERIFY before browser-local ledger mutation.
Added first-class SOURCE URL / EXACT SKU / SELLER-CHANNEL fields so evidence required by the Shopping contract and agent packet is no longer dropped by the ledger UI.
Port carries a literal URL when present but deliberately does not infer SKU/seller or ownership state.
Added shared Shopping INTERPHASE adapter: exact selected item → derived material phase → <=3 native moves → TRACE → exact RETURN.
Primary visible lifecycle compresses to NEED / CANDIDATE / READY / INBOUND / ON_HAND / ADOPTED / CLOSED while detailed native states remain preserved as host-owned residue.
READY is derived from existing purchase-gate evidence; TESTED remains ON_HAND evidence rather than becoming a separate shared phase.
Shopping now emits interphase-action-surface/v0.1 without gaining purchase, seller-contact, HOUSE, Dayline or FIELD authority.
Added bounded MARKET TAPE: up to 12 browser-local exact-offer snapshots retaining checked time, landed SGD, availability, variant, exact SKU/seller/source, return policy and warranty.
Added optional TARGET LANDED SGD; target hit is derived evidence only and cannot trigger purchase, seller contact or lifecycle promotion.
Agent research packet now carries current offer + bounded market summary/history so research can compare fresh evidence without status laundering.
External donor admission retained price-history/watch/identity mechanisms while rejecting autonomous checkout and universal-cart authority.

Primary Shopping field filter now uses the shared material phase projection (NEED / CANDIDATE / READY / INBOUND / ON_HAND / ADOPTED / CLOSED) rather than exposing the detailed native lifecycle as the top-level navigation grammar.
List recognition now foregrounds derived material phase while preserving the exact native Shopping state as explicit visible residue.
Detailed native lifecycle remains editable/host-owned; phase filtering is projection only and cannot mutate procurement truth.
